It features automatic game detection, optional drive scanning, DLSS5-Feeder for compatible titles without native DLSS, emulator support, and compatibility with DirectX 9/10/11/12, Vulkan, and OpenGL.

week.description: Anti-hallucination for AI agents that read binaries. The model proposes, deterministic tools decide: every claim is VERIFIED or REFUTED against the real bytes, with evidence, and grounded facts survive context resets. MCP server + CLI.

week.name: DLSS5-Feeder
week.description: DLSS 5 neural rendering in D3D11/D12/Vulkan games that ship without any DLSS — feeds a synthetic DLAA contract (ReShade depth + motion vectors) to the DLSS 5 add-on via a private D3D12 device.
